title: The valid Noetherian specialization of topological-coefficient torsion-dimension transfer
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, a finite subextension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a finite commutative ring $A$ killed by a power of $\ell$. Let $\Lambda\in\{A,\mathbf Z_\ell,\mathcal O_E,\mathbf Q_\ell,E\}$, with the discrete topology on $A$ and the induced $\ell$-adic topology on the other rings [sk-def-localizing-closure]. The associated condensed ring is $P\mapsto C(P,\Lambda)$ on profinite sets; all continuous functions are used. Let $X$ be an affine locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth] [def-pc-scheme], and use the small étale and pro-étale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], the small-site/indexing universe [def-weil-size-convention], and ordinary internal module-object derived categories [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull].

Let $d\geq0$ be an integer. Assume that for every affine étale morphism $v:V\to X$ [def-weil-etale-morphism], every torsion abelian sheaf $F$ on $V_{\mathrm{et}}$, and every integer $q>d$, one has $H^q(V_{\mathrm{et}},F)=0$ [def-sc-etale-torsion-cd]. Torsion here is local torsion, without a common annihilator.

Put $\Lambda_X=p_X^*\Lambda$ and let $\mathcal P_X$ be the intersection of all replete classes in $\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_X}$ containing zero and every finite constant scalar-model constructible module [sk-def-sfb-constructible], closed under kernels and cokernels of maps between members, extensions, and all small ambient coproducts. Extension closure means that if $0\to M'\to M\to M''\to0$ is exact and $M',M''$ belong to the class, so does $M$. Then for every $M\in\mathcal P_X$ and every integer $q>d+2$,
$$H^q\bigl(R\Gamma(X_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}},M[0])\bigr)=0.$$
Here $R\Gamma$ is the actual right derived functor of global sections of internal $\Lambda_X$-modules to abelian groups. No completion of modules or coefficients is made. No finite-type structure map to a field, characteristic restriction or invertibility of $\ell$ is assumed. Empty $X$, $d=0$, and the zero coefficient ring are included. This is a separate Noetherian specialization. It does not assert or replace the unrestricted affine statement of lem-sfb-torsion-cd-topological-serre-transfer.

proof.text: For every finite constructible complex K apply the finite-complex heart estimate with X, Λ and d. It gives the required local bound c=d+2 at every affine pro-etale test object.

Since X is affine and locally Noetherian, the repaired filtered finite-heart approximation applies. Its ind class is replete and is closed under ambient kernels, cokernels, extensions and small coproducts and contains every generator. The defining minimality of the weak Serre coproduct hull puts M in this ind class.

For a finite-complex heart use the local estimate at U=X with the identity morphism. The canonical identity inverse-image isomorphism removes the pullback, and functoriality transports vanishing along the finite-heart presentation isomorphism. Apply fixed-degree vanishing on the filtered-colimit hull at q>d+2.

lean.statement:
theorem torsionCd_topological_serreHeart_cohomology_vanishes_of_locallyNoetherian
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    (hΛ :
      (∃ (A : Type) (_ : CommRing A) (_ : TopologicalSpace A)
          (_ : DiscreteTopology A) (_ : IsTopologicalRing A),
        Finite A ∧ (∃ n : ℕ, ∀ a : A, (ℓ ^ n) • a = 0) ∧
          Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj A))) ∨
      Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj ℤ_[ℓ])) ∨
      (∃ E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ,
        Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E))) ∨
      Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj ℚ_[ℓ])) ∨
      (∃ E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ,
        Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E))))
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (d : ℕ)
    (hcd : ∀ (V : Scheme.{u}) (v : V ⟶ X) [IsAffine V] [Etale v],
      V.HasTorsionEtaleCohomologicalDimensionLE d)
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))
    (hM : ObjectProperty.weakSerreCoproductClosure.{u + 1}
      (IsConstantModelConstructible Λ X) M)
    (q : ℤ) (hq : (d : ℤ) + 2 < q) :
    IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
      ((condensedModuleSections Λ X).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)))

statement_change.what: Decision of the human, 2026-10-25: the ring of all continuous maps to the algebraic closure (continuousMapRingObj (PadicAlgCl l)) is no longer an admissible coefficient (commit 66b1ce0e791, coord/changes/L-coefficient-allcontinuous-removal.md). That commit narrowed the roots of this chain (weak-Serre generation, torsion-cd Serre transfer) to A, Z_l, O_E, Q_l, E, but this statement still listed the all-continuous case. It is dropped here and from the Lean hypothesis (landing L 20261025T093525); the remaining coefficients are unchanged. No citer uses the dropped case.
